title: Multiple feeds with unknown original provenance
question: Do these posts establish that a fictional dam has failed?

events.title: Forwarded message claims Greywater dam collapse
events.summary: An anonymous forwarded message reports a collapse. No original author, photograph, timestamp or location verification is supplied.

events.title: Greywater failure rumour appears on another feed

reference_facts: Only unverified forwarded allegations are supplied.
